per_article_summaries: Lewis Hamilton turned up at the Miami Grand Prix in a full Saint Laurent look. The Ferrari driver's ensemble featured a striking, translucent, bright orange anorak worn over a tailored, satin, burnt orange collared shirt and burgundy tie. This was paired with relaxed-fit, pleated dark brown trousers and classic black leather shoes.

Red Bull face a challenge to retain four-time F1 champion Max Verstappen, says Martin Brundle. The Dutchman has revealed that he is considering walking away from the championship at the end of the current season. Brundle says Mercedes, McLaren and Ferrari have the talent to retain Verstappen.

Colton Herta has joined Cadillac F1 as a test driver in 2026. The American driver had previously considered a move to F1 in 2021. A deal with AlphaTauri (now Racing Bulls) failed to come to fruition for the 2023 season.

Max Verstappen has described the Formula 1 regulation changes as ‘just a tickle’ The Red Bull driver sees the greater communication and interaction between the drivers and rule makers as a positive development. The four-time world champion has held several meetings with F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali.

Apple SVP Eddy Cue says viewership is "way up" versus last year's numbers by ESPN. On top of this, fans are watching more than just Sunday's grand prix. Apple is paying $150million annually for these broadcast rights over a five-year contract.

Max Verstappen says he has 'life decisions' to make about his F1 future. The Red Bull driver has been one of the biggest critics of the new ruleset. The 28-year-old will contest the Nurburgring 24 Hours on 16-17 May.

The Formula 1 Miami Grand Prix has become the defining blueprint for what a global sporting spectacle looks like in the United States. It has become a cultural force that sits at the intersection of sports, fashion, tech, music, and entertainment. In 2025, South Florida Motorsports and Formula 1 locked in a 10-year extension, keeping the race on the calendar through 2041.

All 22 Formula 1 drivers were united in the discussions with the FIA and Formula One Management regarding the 2026 regulations. The regulations were discussed during the impromptu five-week break between the Japanese and Miami Grands Prix. As a result of those talks, tweaks have been introduced for this weekend's race at the Miami International Autodrome.

Stefano Domenicali says F1 is only scratching the surface of its commercial potential in the United States. Domenicali revealed that there was interest in hosting more than the current three American races in Miami, Austin and Las Vegas.

Max Verstappen believes that Red Bull's upgrades have so far "almost halved" the gap to the leaders. Verstappen took it to fifth on the grid for the Miami sprint race, just under 0.6s off Lando Norris' pole time. Red Bull caught the eye with its own interpretation of the "Macarena" rear wing.

The FIA is assessing whether it is necessary to move the start time of the Miami Grand Prix, based on the latest weather predictions. Potentially heavy rain and thunderstorms are forecast for Sunday, which could make it necessary to adjust the Formula 1 timetable. Two meetings are scheduled to take place after Saturday’s qualifying session to decide whether that is the most sensible time slot.

Liam Lawson had been eliminated in the first phase of qualifying for the Miami GP sprint race. His team was hoping he would be allowed to return to the track. The belief was that Alex Albon's Williams would be penalised for exceeding track limits on the lap that put him 16th in SQ1, leaving Lawson 17th and therefore knocked out. Albon had indeed gone beyond track limits at Turn 6 in setting the 1m30.216s lap, but this was not picked up at the time.

F1 has given a key role to battery management during grands prix and, due to varying power levels throughout the grid, it has caused a new style of racing called ‘yo-yo’ The rules' naysayers claim that moves have become artificial and wheel-to-wheel battles have ultimately been devalued. Ferrari boss Fred Vasseur claimed that the 2026 Formula 1 regulations are “less artificial” than DRS.

Lando Norris set the fastest time in sprint qualifying at the F1 Miami Grand Prix. The provisional starting grid is pending final approval by the FIA. The 2026 Miami Grand Prix sprint race will be held in Miami, Florida. The race will be the first to be held in the U.S. since 2008.

Kimi Antonelli claims his third successive pole at the Miami Grand Prix. Max Verstappen finishes second ahead of Ferrari's Charles Leclerc. Championship leader Kimi Antonelli will start on the front row on Sunday. The start of the race is planned for 4pm local time on Sunday.

Gabriel Bortoleto has been disqualified from the Miami sprint race. Bortoleto's car's engine intake air pressure was found to have exceeded the permitted limit. His team-mate Nico Hulkenberg failed to start the sprint race after his car caught fire.

During the race weekend in Miami, drivers have been able to get their first taste of the changes to the technical regulations. The tweaks to energy management are intended to address the, at times, dangerous closing speeds and make qualifying more on the limit. Reigning world champion Lando Norris describes it as a first step in the right direction.

Jenson Button has branded Kimi Antonelli's track limits infringement during the Miami sprint race a "silly mistake" The Italian driver crossed the line in fourth, but was classified sixth after being handed a five-second penalty due to exceeding track limits. Former F1 driver Timo Glock also discussed Antonelli's penalty and poor race start.

Ferrari driver Charles Leclerc says he was "a bit harsh" with his criticism of Kimi Antonelli during Miami's sprint race. Leclerc and Antonelli came to blows twice over the course of Antonelli's rookie season, with the Mercedes youngster taking Leclerc out at the Dutch Grand Prix, and also playing a part in a three-car collision in Brazil. Antonelli finished fourth but was eventually handed a post-race five-second penalty for repeated track limits offences.

Kimi Antonelli dropped from second to fourth on lap one of the Miami Grand Prix. Mercedes driver has now lost 20 positions at race start across the opening three grands prix and two sprints of 2026. Antonelli dropped to sixth post-race following a five-second track limits penalty, handing fourth to team-mate George Russell.

Colton Herta is competing in the Formula 2 championship with Hitech. The 26-year-old left his successful career in IndyCar to pursue his F1 dream. Herta is a test driver for the Cadillac F1 team. In F2, drivers are given just a single free practice session.

McLaren Formula 1 team principal Andrea Stella is cautiously optimistic about the team's upgrades. The Woking outfit turned up to the Miami Grand Prix with an almost new car after working on extensive upgrades during the five-week break in April. Norris and Piastri finished with a strong 1-2 finish in the sprint race.

Isack Hadjar has been officially disqualified from qualifying for this weekend’s Miami Grand Prix after his Red Bull fell foul of the Formula 1 technical regulations. The 21-year-old’s RB22 was in breach of Article C3.5. of the F1 regulations because his left hand side and right hand side floorboards were beyond the permitted dimension. The Frenchman will now start Sunday’s race from the pitlane after initially qualifying ninth.

Valtteri Bottas qualifies 20th for Sunday's Miami Grand Prix. The Mercedes driver says his Cadillac feels 'like a different car' to previous years. Cadillac is one of two teams yet to score a point in the 2026 Formula 1 season.

Isack Hadjar finished 0.825s behind Red Bull team-mate Max Verstappen in qualifying for the Formula 1 Miami Grand Prix. The Frenchman was disqualified over a technical infringement. But Hadjar believes the eight tenths difference isn’t down to just pure pace.

Kimi Antonelli on pole for Sunday's Formula 1 Miami Grand Prix. Mercedes team-mate George Russell says track is very low on grip. Antonelli qualified four tenths ahead of Russell in fifth. Russell is seven points behind Antonelli in the F1 standings.

Max Verstappen will start on the front row for Sunday's race in Miami. The Red Bull driver was not even in Q3 in Japan. Verstappen says he feels more comfortable in the RB22 and is able to push more. The Dutchman also sees it reflected in the mood within the team.

The Miami Grand Prix was the fourth race of the 2026 Formula 1 season. The race was held at the Miami International Circuit. The race was the first of four scheduled races in the 2026 season. The Miami Grand Prix was the first of four races in the 2026 F1 season.

Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli defeated McLaren's Lando Norris to take his third consecutive grand prix win, expanding his championship lead on Russell to 20 points. Red Bull's Max Verstappen will have to report to the stewards for crossing the pit exit line after his only pitstop. Ferrari driver Charles Leclerc is also under investigation for both leaving the track and gaining an advantage.

FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem says V8s will return to F1 by 2031. The V8 was ditched for a V6 turbohybrid in 2014 and F1 has now entered its third regulation cycle since the electrified power units were introduced. The 2026 ruleset is proving contentious with a near-50:50 split between combustion and electric energy.

Ferrari driver Charles Leclerc has placed the blame on himself after a late spin in the Miami Grand Prix cost him a podium finish. The Monegasque driver had just lost third position to McLaren's Oscar Piastri when he went to overtake the Australian, but he spun out as he pushed to make the move. While he avoided a massive crash, he did clip the wall and lost further positions to George Russell and Max Verstappen.

McLaren Racing CEO Zak Brown has likened modern Formula 1 to a series of 24 Super Bowls for fans. Brown was speaking at the Autosport Business Exchange Miami ahead of the Miami Grand Prix. The American believes modern race weekends cater for both business-to-business and fan-facing partners.

Kimi Antonelli takes third consecutive race win of 2026 at Miami Grand Prix. Holds off Lando Norris with Oscar Piastri completing the podium for McLaren. Charles Leclerc spins on final lap, allowing George Russell into fourth and Max Verstappen to take sixth ahead of the Monegasque. Red Bull's Isack Hadjar crashes at chicane while working his way up the order.
